citation: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 3, section 3.3.58 Get corresponding identifiers (QBP) and response (RSP) (events Q23 and K23), p 3-55. Triggers Table 0354 v2.4 (Chapter 2, section 2.17.3, p 2-140) maps to RSP_K23 that no caption prints, accepted with the printed ones (P8b-11 ruling): RSP^K24.

errorResponse.citation: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 5, section 5.6.5 Query error response, p 5-62: an error is returned as AE or AR in MSA-1 'of the applicable query response message'; the AR response (Situation 1) is 'a negative ACK message containing the MSH, MSA and the ERR'; the AE response (Situation 2) 'contains the MSH, MSA, ERR, QAK and the query defining segment if available' and 'The rest of the message is absent'; the DSC 'is not sent or, if it is, its continuation pointer field' is null. Each query response the version prints (a structure with MSA and QAK, QRD, QPD or ERQ) is listed with the query defining segments its own print carries, none where it echoes no query segment (ADR-019 S4-3).
